mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BRANCHES (branch_code, branch_name, address, phone_number, is_active) VALUES (#{branchCode}, #{branchName}, #{address}, #{phoneNumber}, #{isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE BRANCHES SET branch_code = #{branchCode}, branch_name = #{branchName}, address = #{address}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE branch_id = #{branchId}
mapper.select: SELECT branch_id, branch_code, branch_name, address, phone_number, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM BRANCHES ORDER BY branch_name ASC

SELECT branch_id, branch_code, branch_name, address, phone_number, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM BRANCHES
AND ( LOWER(branch_code) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(branch_name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(address) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) )
ORDER BY
branch_code branch_name created_at created_at
DESC ASC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
